title: Ledup reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it into place (24px by default, any distance, or none for a plain fade) over the first stretch of scroll after it enters the window. Steps stagger cards in a row.
notes: CSS only (view timeline): browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the content in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
name: ledup-reveal

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (div by default)

props.name: distance
props.description: how far it rises, in px (0 = fade only)

props.name: step
props.description: position in a staggered row: 0, 1, 2… each arrives 60px of scroll later
